questions.q: ------- the shipment arrived late, the customer still placed another order.
questions.why: 後ろが節（S+V）で、前後が逆接の関係なので接続詞 Although。Despite は前置詞で節を取れない。

questions.q: Please submit your expense report ------- you return from the business trip.
questions.why: 「戻ったらすぐに」という時を表す接続詞 as soon as が自然。

questions.q: The seminar will be moved indoors ------- it rains on Saturday.
questions.why: 「雨が降った場合」の条件を表す if。unless は「降らない限り」で意味が逆になる。

questions.q: Ms. Tanaka will lead the workshop ------- Mr. Reyes is on leave.
questions.why: 後ろが節（S+V）なので接続詞の while。during などは前置詞で名詞しか取れない。

questions.q: The store will remain open late ------- customers have enough time to finish holiday shopping.
questions.why: 目的を表す so that「～できるように」が合う。

questions.q: All visitors must sign in at the front desk ------- entering the laboratory.
questions.why: 動名詞 entering を伴い「入る前に」を表せるのは before。during の後ろには動名詞を置けない。

questions.q: The new branch is located ------- the river, about five minutes from the station.
questions.why: 「川沿いに」は along the river。among・between は複数のものの間を表す。

questions.q: Employees may work remotely ------- the end of the quarter.
questions.why: 「期末まで（ずっと）」と継続の期限を表す until。since は過去の起点を表す。

questions.q: The company's profits rose ------- 12 percent last year.
questions.why: 増減の差・幅を表す前置詞は by。「12パーセント増えた」。

questions.q: The candidate ------- résumé impressed the committee was invited for a second interview.
questions.why: 直後に名詞（résumé）があり「その人の履歴書」と所有を表すので whose。

questions.q: The report includes a chart ------- shows the sales trend by region.
questions.why: 先行詞は物（a chart）で、後ろは主語が欠けた節。主格の that が入る。what は先行詞を取らない。

questions.q: Mr. Okafor, ------- we hired last spring, has already won two regional awards.
questions.why: 先行詞は人で、hired の目的語が欠けている。目的格の whom が入る。

questions.q: Rarely ------- so many applications for a single position.
questions.why: 否定の副詞 Rarely が文頭に来ると、助動詞が主語の前に出る倒置になる。

questions.q: The ------- of the new payroll system will be completed by the end of March.
questions.why: 冠詞 The のあと、of の前には名詞が入る。「導入」という意味の installation。

questions.q: Ms. Park is a highly ------- negotiator who has closed many large contracts.
questions.why: 副詞 highly を受けて名詞 negotiator を修飾する形容詞が必要。「熟練した」。

questions.q: If the supplier had delivered the parts earlier, the factory ------- its deadline.
questions.why: if 節が過去完了の仮定法過去完了なので、主節は would have＋過去分詞。

questions.q: Applicants are required ------- two letters of recommendation with their forms.
questions.why: be required to ～ の形。to のあとは動詞の原形。

questions.q: Ms. Chen reviewed the contract ------- before signing it.
questions.why: 主語と同じ人を強調する再帰代名詞 herself。「自分自身で」。

questions.q: The new model is ------- more efficient than the one it replaces.
questions.why: 比較級を強める副詞は considerably（ずっと）。very・too・so は比較級を修飾できない。

questions.q: The number of applicants for the internship ------- increased this year.
questions.why: The number of ～ は「～の数」で単数扱い。現在完了なので has。

questions.q: The hotel offers a ------- breakfast to all guests staying more than two nights.
questions.why: 「無料の」朝食を提供するという文脈なので complimentary。

questions.q: Mr. Walsh was ------- for ensuring that all safety inspections were completed.
questions.why: be responsible for ～「～に責任がある」の形。

questions.q: Due to unexpected maintenance, the train service has been ------- suspended.
questions.why: 「一時的に」運休しているという意味の temporarily。

questions.q: The manager asked the team to ------- the proposal before presenting it to the board.
questions.why: 役員会に出す前に提案書を「修正する」ので revise。

questions.q: Customers may ------- their orders online until noon on the day of delivery.
questions.why: 注文を「変更する」という意味の modify が合う。

questions.q: The firm's ------- to quality has earned it many long-term clients.
questions.why: commitment to ～「～への取り組み・献身」が自然。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez was ------- to the position of regional director after five years with the company.
questions.why: be promoted to ～「～に昇進する」。

questions.q: A ------- of ten percent will be applied to orders over $500.
questions.why: 注文に適用される10パーセントの「割引」。

questions.q: Please keep the receipt as ------- of purchase.
questions.why: proof of purchase は「購入証明」という決まった表現。

questions.q: The conference room is ------- equipped with a projector and a video-calling system.
questions.why: 「設備が完備された」という意味で fully equipped。
前置詞 In と for にはさまれた空所には名詞が入る。In preparation for ～ =「～に備えて」。

c: The cafeteria will serve a special lunch on Friday afternoon.

Several managers have already left the company this year.
The old building was constructed more than fifty years ago.

予約システム「を通じて」個室を予約する、という手段を表す前置詞 through。
「机に正しく置けるように」という目的を表す so that。
後ろに節（our workshop is short of materials）が続くので接続詞 because。because of は名詞しか取れない。
be expected to ～「～する見込みである」の受け身の形。

c: The dining table is available in three colors.
Your membership will expire at the end of the year.

questions.why: 遅延の報告のあと、次の「ご迷惑をおかけするかもしれない」へつながる、おわびの文が自然。
「11月20日までに」と期限を表す by。
先行詞は renovation（物）で、後ろは主語が欠けている。主格の関係代名詞 that が入る。
数字 40 percent を修飾するので副詞が入る。「およそ40パーセント」。

c: Parking near the harbor is free on weekends.
Several bus routes will change in January.
Funding for the project came from both the city government and the community.
Ms. Nair previously worked at a university in Boston.
questions.why: 次の文の「住民が寄付した」につながる、資金源に触れる文が自然。他の文は話の流れと関係がない。
Library cards を後ろから修飾する過去分詞。「発行されたカード」。
全営業職員が受けるべき研修なので「必須の」mandatory が合う。
at ～ own convenience の空所には所有格が入る。主語 you に合わせて your。

c: The cafeteria menu will change next week.

questions.why: 次の「早く終えた人には修了証」とつながる、受講期限を伝える文が自然。

RIVERTON TO TRIAL ELECTRIC BUSES

RIVERTON (November 5) — The Riverton Transit Authority announced yesterday that it will begin a six-month trial of electric buses on Route 12, which links the downtown terminal with the university campus. Three buses will enter service on January 11, replacing diesel vehicles that have operated on the route for more than a decade.

Authority director Gloria Santos said the trial will measure operating costs, battery performance in cold weather, and passenger satisfaction. "If the results are positive, we will purchase up to twenty additional buses over the next five years," she said. The vehicles were funded by a regional grant that covers 60 percent of the purchase price.

Some residents have expressed concern about noise at the new charging station near Eastgate Road. The authority has promised to install sound barriers before the buses begin running. Fares on Route 12 will remain unchanged during the trial.

FOOD COMPANY TO EXPAND IN MARLOW

MARLOW (March 3) — Tessel Foods, a maker of frozen meals, will build a second production facility in Marlow, the company announced on Monday. The 20,000-square-meter plant is expected to open in September and create 150 jobs, mostly in packaging and quality control. The company's existing plant in Dorrance, which employs 320 people, has been running at full capacity since last year.

"Demand for our vegetarian line has doubled in two years," said CEO Camille Duval. "The new plant will let us meet that demand and shorten delivery times to customers in the north." Marlow's mayor, Felix Arden, welcomed the news, noting that the town offered tax benefits to attract the project. Construction is scheduled to begin in April, and recruitment will start in June.

LOCAL BAKERY NAMED REGION'S BEST

OAKHAVEN (October 24) — Marlowe's Bakery, a family-run shop on Mill Street, has been named Best Small Business of the Year by the Oakhaven Chamber of Commerce. Founded in 1998 by Elena Marlowe, the bakery now employs 14 people and sells bread to six local restaurants. Judges praised its use of locally grown grain and its apprenticeship program for young bakers. To celebrate, the bakery will offer a free pastry with any drink purchase this Saturday and will extend its hours until 7 P.M. through the end of the month. Ms. Marlowe said she plans to open a second location in the Eastside district next spring.

docs.label: Online review
docs.text:
★★★★☆  Reviewed by Tobias K., November 1

I stopped by Marlowe's after reading about the award, and I'm glad I did. The sourdough loaf was among the best I've had, and the staff were friendly. My only complaint is that the line was out the door at 10 A.M., and it took nearly 25 minutes to be served. They only had one register open. I'd happily return, but perhaps on a weekday. Also, the free pastry offer had already ended by the time I visited, so check the dates before you go!

docs.label: Response
docs.text:
Response from Elena Marlowe, November 2

Thank you, Tobias, for your kind words and honest feedback. We were surprised by the number of visitors after the award, and we are sorry about the wait. Starting next week, we will open a second register from 9 to 11 A.M. on weekends and add a pre-order option on our Web site, so you can pick up bread without waiting in line. We hope to see you again soon.
